0.original: Dmitar has exciting news to share from the southern front.

48.original: A Resistance rank of <hex:022003E80203> is required to proceed with this quest.

49.original: Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>! We received word from the field─the Empire's forces have fallen back!

50.original: In fact, our troops have pushed forward far enough as to claim an enemy encampment near the southern entrenchment.

51.original: My commanding officer has instructed me to give you a brief tour of the site at your earliest convenience. I will await you there.

52.original: Welcome to Olana's Stand. If you wish to travel between here and Utya's Aegis, feel free to use that aetheryte shard over there. I would suggest attuning to it before you leave.

53.original: And one last thing: while we've made great strides in our fight against the Empire, there's still much to be done before we can retake Castrum Lacus Litore.

54.original: I expect the enemy will only grow more determined as we advance forward, but we must press on. For Bozja!

55.original: The Resistance front line advances, allowing you to participate in new skirmishes and critical engagements.

56.original: The next quest can be accepted by speaking with Mikoto after reaching Resistance rank <hex:022003E80203> or higher.
